profile.details: Junior Full Stack Developer | Video Editor

aboutBubbles: I am a 4th-year Bachelor of Science in Information Technology student from Holy Cross of Davao College with hands-on experience in developing modern web applications and backend-integrated systems. I specialize in building responsive user interfaces using React.js and implementing backend solutions with Laravel, including API integration and database management using MySQL and Supabase.

During my internship at INFOSOFT in Davao City, I gained practical experience in backend integration, debugging, and deploying applications using Docker. I also worked with Git for version control and contributed to improving UI/UX through clean and functional code implementation.
In addition to development, I have professional experience as a video editor, which strengthened my attention to detail, creativity, and ability to deliver high-quality outputs under deadlines.

I am a fast learner with strong problem-solving skills, committed to writing clean, maintainable code and continuously improving my technical expertise. I am seeking an opportunity as a Junior Developer where I can contribute to real-world projects while growing in a collaborative environment.
